notes: Coordinate conversion (sources: rdomap): RDOMap stores Leaflet [lat, lng] (its JSON fields named x,y in singleplayer.json/fasttravels.json are lat,lng; discoverables.json uses lat,lng). Its own code assets/js/map.js gameToMap() and dev/bounty/index.js use lat = 0.01552 * gameY + -63.6 and lng = 0.01552 * gameX + 111.29. Inverted here: gameX = (lng - 111.29) / 0.01552, gameY = (lat + 63.6) / 0.01552. Raw values are kept in each pin's datasetRef. Map values are stored to 4 decimals, so round-trip error is < 0.01 game units from rounding alone.

Sanity check of the conversion (sources: rdomap): Saint Denis fast-travel point converts to about (2667, -1468) and Blackwater to about (-744, -1247), i.e. south-east and south-west quadrants as expected; Colter converts to far north (y ~ 2423).

Dino bones, dreamcatchers and rock carvings come from RDOMap data/singleplayer.json which carries exact point markers (approximate=false). Pin numbering (01..30 etc.) is the dataset's own order, NOT an official in-game or guide numbering; the merge must match pins to guide entries by position/description, not by number (sources: rdomap).

Legendary animals and legendary fish positions come from RDOMap data/discoverables.json key 'sp_legendaries', which is a list of overlay ICON placements (width/height 90-100 px) drawn over the map for the story-mode legendary areas. They mark the general area, not an exact spawn/fishing spot, so all are approximate=true (sources: rdomap).

Cross-check inside RDOMap (sources: rdomap): the 30 dino-bone points in singleplayer.json and discoverables.json agree within 7.8 game units; the 10 rock carvings agree within 40.6 game units (discoverables.json icons are overlay placements, so the singleplayer.json points are used).

CAUTION on camp/landmark text-label pins: text-label anchors were not validated against the true site and could be offset by a few hundred game units (e.g. Horseshoe Overlook converts to (-208, 17)). Use them only to place a map LABEL, never as the precise location of a mission/collectible (sources: rdomap).
RDOMap data/animal_legendary.json is Red Dead ONLINE legendary animals (e.g. 'Teca Gator'), not story mode; it was NOT used (sources: rdomap).

Town reference points use RDOMap data/fasttravels.json (Red Dead Online fast-travel signposts). These are inside or at the edge of each settlement (often the station), so they are marked approximate=true for 'town' purposes. Covered: Annesburg, Armadillo, Blackwater, Colter, Emerald Ranch, Lagras, MacFarlane's Ranch, Manzanita Post, Rhodes, Saint Denis, Strawberry, Tumbleweed, Valentine, Van Horn, Wapiti (sources: rdomap).

Camp/landmark reference points (Beaver Hollow, Clemens Point, Colter camp, Horseshoe Overlook, Shady Belle, Beecher's Hope, Van Horn Mansion, Fort Riggs, Cueva Seco, Adler Ranch) come from RDOMap discoverables.json 'text' overlays = anchor of a map text-label image; approximate=true (sources: rdomap).

CIGARETTE CARDS: no permissively licensed dataset with story-mode cigarette card coordinates was found (searched GitHub repos and code for rdr2/rdr3 map data and 'cigarette_card'). Zero pins extracted. The 144 total (12 sets x 12 cards) was not re-verified in this pass. Card pins must NOT be guessed; the guide should use text directions only (sources: rdomap).

femga/rdr3_discoveries has no LICENSE file (GitHub license API returns 404; root lists README.md and data folders only) -> all rights reserved by default; nothing was extracted from it (sources: femga).

RDOMap singleplayer.json also contains story-mode graves (9), orchids, alligator eggs, wilderness chests (83) and crayfish holes; not extracted here (graves carry spoiler names) but available under the same Unlicense if wanted later (sources: rdomap).

Line data for drawing our own base map: RDR2CollectorsMap data/geojson/{ambarino,lemoyne,new-austin,new-hanover,west-elizabeth,fasttravel,railroads}.json are GeoJSON LineStrings (coordinates [lng, lat] in the same Leaflet space; same conversion applies) forming the ROAD/TRAIL and RAILROAD network used by the site's route pathfinder (assets/js/pathfinder.worker.js). Unlicense. They are NOT coastlines, rivers or region borders. No open-licensed coast/water/region polygon dataset was found (sources: collectorsmap).

Map imagery: neither jeanropke repo ships tiles in git; both README files link to a separate download of 'rdr3 tiles' on a CDN with no licence statement. The tiles are Rockstar's in-game map art; the Unlicense on the repos covers the authors' code/data, not Rockstar's artwork. Do NOT bundle tiles (sources: rdomap, collectorsmap).

Set 'labels' (sources: rdomap): place-name reference points for drawing our own map. From RDOMap discoverables.json 'text' overlays (landmark_/homestead_/settlement_/hideout_/discoverabletext_/eventarea_ keys; text-label anchors, approximate=true; shack_* keys skipped because they are internal stranger/spoiler names, and ones already present as camps/landmarks pins are not duplicated), shops.json wardrobe points (keys spell the settlement name, e.g. shop_hrt_wardrobe_valentine; exact shop points, approximate=false) and nine interiors.json buildings whose code names a place (e.g. wal_trainstation_int), each accepted only because it lies 5-231 units from a full-named anchor (approximate=false). Label names are humanised from the dataset keys.

Fast-travel town points are at the train stations: e.g. Valentine fast travel (-186, 644) is 20 units from the Valentine station interior point (-181, 627); Emerald 9 units from the Emerald depot; Annesburg 14 units from its depot (sources: rdomap).

No open dataset with labels for states/regions, mountains, lakes, rivers, or major map-text names (e.g. THE HEARTLANDS, DAKOTA RIVER, Cattail Pond, Flatneck Station, Elysian Pool) was found. In the jeanropke maps those names are part of Rockstar's tile artwork, not data (sources: rdomap, collectorsmap).

Set 'graves' (sources: rdomap): 8 points from discoverables.json 'grave' group, labelled neutrally 'Grave site'; ids are a hash of the raw key; the raw key (a character name, spoiler) is only in datasetRef. The overlay icons are approximate. singleplayer.json has a 9th grave key not in this group.

the0neWhoKnocks/red-dead-redemption-2-map (MIT) has 705 hand-placed markers incl. 150 cigarette cards, but its bin/scrape-tiles.sh downloads IGN's map tiles and its marker names match IGN's interactive map, so the data is very likely copied from IGN; its coordinates are also in IGN's tile space, not jeanropke's. Rejected: not used (sources: the0ne).
pin-links.json links map pins to collectibles.json text items only where an open-licensed label position makes the match clear; see its 'method' field (sources: rdomap).

disputes.details: RDOMap singleplayer.json has 20 dreamcatcher points; RDOMap discoverables.json overlay layer has 21 dreamcatcher icons. The extra overlay icon has no match within 0.1 map units in singleplayer.json: raw lat=-75.5195, lng=95.4003 -> game (-1023.8, -768.0).
disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the 20 singleplayer.json points (matches the known set size of 20). Do not pin the extra overlay icon.

disputes.details: Jeremy Gill's 'A Fisher of Fish' needs 13 legendary fish; the Legendary Channel Catfish unlocks after mailing those (14 total per Fextralife). RDR2.org also lists the Legendary Northern Pike (obtained separately), and RDOMap's story overlay has 15 fish icons including both.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Show all 15 pins but label Channel Catfish and Northern Pike as extras outside the 13 needed for 'A Fisher of Fish'.

disputes.details: RDOMap's runtime map.js and bounty scripts use +111.29; an older dev script (dev/scripts/port-source-coords-to-website-coords.js) uses +111.294. The difference is 0.004 map units = about 0.26 game units in X.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Use 111.29 (the live site constant); the difference is negligible at any map zoom.
